identity.fullname: AI and Machine Learning Foundations on Google Cloud
identity.summary: A vendor-grounded conceptual foundation built from Google Cloud's own explainers: what artificial intelligence and machine learning are and how they relate, what generative AI is, and how MLOps keeps models running in production.

brief.topic: AI and Machine Learning Foundations on Google Cloud
brief.audience: Developers and technology professionals new to AI/ML who want a conceptual foundation before using Google Cloud's ML tools
brief.intended_learning_outcome: Explain what artificial intelligence, machine learning, and generative AI are, how they relate to each other, and how MLOps keeps models running in production

sources.title: What is artificial intelligence (AI)?
sources.activity_purpose: Define artificial intelligence, its main types, and common applications.

sources.title: What is machine learning (ML)?
sources.activity_purpose: Understand how machine learning works, supervised vs. unsupervised learning, and where it is used.

sources.title: Artificial intelligence vs. machine learning
sources.activity_purpose: Place AI, ML, and deep learning in relation to one another and know when each term applies.

sources.title: What is generative AI?
sources.activity_purpose: Learn what generative AI and foundation models are and how they differ from traditional ML.

sources.title: What is MLOps?
sources.activity_purpose: See how MLOps applies DevOps practices to build, deploy, monitor, and retrain models in production.
